fact_text: The artist said his detailing business started in 2006, when detailing was not a recognised service in Pakistan and painters did the rubbing work.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'When Cars Become Canvases: The Business of Automotive Art | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-04)

fact_text: The artist said ceramic-style coatings reached Pakistan around 2012-13, and that paint protection film began arriving in better quality after 2021.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'When Cars Become Canvases: The Business of Automotive Art | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-04)

fact_text: The artist's Karachi venture offers custom calligraphy-style artwork on cars, helmets and motorbike parts, a service the artist said had not been offered in Pakistan before.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'When Cars Become Canvases: The Business of Automotive Art | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-04)

fact_text: The artist said a painted car travels to many places and reaches far more viewers than a gallery work that hangs in one room.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'When Cars Become Canvases: The Business of Automotive Art | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-04)

fact_text: The artist said Pakistan has no degree or school course in graffiti or custom painting, and that family and friends often discourage young people from building a career in it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'When Cars Become Canvases: The Business of Automotive Art | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-04)

fact_text: The artist said specialised brushes and tools are hard to source in Pakistan, so his team orders through contacts and pays duty, while the same tools are easy to buy abroad.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'When Cars Become Canvases: The Business of Automotive Art | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-04)

fact_text: The artist said a custom art job abroad commonly starts around $500 and can run to $2,000, and that his studio plans mid-range pricing so more buyers can commission work.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'When Cars Become Canvases: The Business of Automotive Art | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-04)

fact_text: The artist said custom artwork is priced on the artist's skill rather than on product cost, since the colours and tools used can themselves be expensive.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'When Cars Become Canvases: The Business of Automotive Art | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-04)

fact_text: The artist said starting prices for this work abroad are higher than the salary of a doctor in Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'When Cars Become Canvases: The Business of Automotive Art | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-10-04)
